svg.text: Manage control nodes, administrator access, certificates and configuration.

g.text: Website identity for https://control.loom/ · administrator login is managed separately.
HTTPS server · serverAuth · not a CA

Keep the current entry until the new certificate and browser access have been verified.
Using the same trust root does not require browsers to import it again.
If this entry expires, use another valid control entry or the protected local CLI for recovery.
